name: Quiver Clash
hook: One arrow, one life. Last archer standing wins.
how: Shoot in eight directions from a quiver of three, and pull your arrows back out of the walls. A dodge at the right moment catches an arrow out of the air, and landing on a head counts too. The edges wrap around. Last one standing takes the round; first to three rounds wins.
controls: Arrow keys with Z, X and C, or a thumb stick with Jump, Shoot and Dodge
uses: The players with the most match wins.
The host's browser calls each round, keeps score and hands out the arrows lying around and the chests; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the empty seats: they hunt, dodge, catch arrows and go back for more.
Every archer and every arrow in flight shows up on all screens at once.
ideas: Add a laser arrow that goes straight through walls
Make it a jungle arena with vines you can climb
Give everyone a shield that blocks one arrow
